verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never says whether funds sit in FBO pools or individual accounts, where FDIC insurance attaches, or who can view the ledger. It only shows that a FinancialAccount is a container separate from the payments balance, that Transactions serve as ledger entries, and that an embeddable disclosure component exists. None of these documents the account structure the story asks about, so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the account structure is transparent — whether funds sit in FBO pools or individual accounts, where FDIC insurance actually attaches, and who can see the ledger, all documented plainly
